name: 防水防汗全身涂抹防晒乳款

category.leaf: 防水防汗全身适用水感防晒乳

description: 水感轻薄快速成膜、防水防汗、全身大面积涂抹不油腻的户外防晒乳

styleLock.direction: fresh outdoor body-sunscreen commerce, cool aquatic daylight
styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF packshots paired with pale ice-blue #DCEBF5 water-ripple panels and matte white stone ledges
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright cool 6000K daylight studio, front-top key with soft fill, gentle sheen on glossy surfaces, soft short contact shadows, no harsh specular blowout
styleLock.surfaceSystem: wet smooth pale-blue glass #CFE4F2 with soft water ripples, matte white stone #F2F4F6
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal-blue #2E3A45, all copy wrapped in 「」, no mixed fonts
styleLock.iconSystem: thin monoline icons inside hexagonal outline badges, single #F2A33C or #2E3A45 stroke, no filled, glossy or 3D icons
styleLock.presentationRules: stable upright product silhouette and consistent scale across the set, slight 3/4 hero angle reused for every product-forward screen, product always grounded with a soft contact shadow
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh outdoor body-sunscreen visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, pale ice-blue #DCEBF5, charcoal-blue text #2E3A45 and one daylight-orange accent #F2A33C; cool 6000K bright daylight studio lighting with a front-top key and soft fill, soft short contact shadows and a gentle sheen on glossy surfaces; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal-blue; consistent rounded info labels; consistent thin monoline icons in hexagonal outline badges; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright product silhouette and scale with a grounded contact shadow; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no warm color cast.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规、轮廓清晰
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, upright product centered, full product visible and never clipped
shots.lighting: bright even high-key 6000K studio light, front key with soft fill, single soft short contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A clean marketplace packshot: the product standing upright, shot straight-on at eye level, full product visible and not clipped, filling 60-70% of the frame so the silhouette reads large and confident. Bright even high-key 6000K studio light from the front with soft fill, one soft short contact shadow grounding the product. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, no props and no text. Commercial e-commerce quality, crisp edges, clean silhouette. Negative: no props, no hands, no deformed hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no cut-off edges, no gradient background, no floating product without contact shadow.

shots.props: three thin monoline icons inside hexagonal outline badges

shots.intent: 放大夏天黏腻厚重、一出汗就滑掉的日常困扰
shots.camera: matched two-panel split screen, identical side angle, camera position, framing and crop on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel flat harsh top light on the problem side, right panel cool clean daylight
shots.props: a compact mirror on the left panel only
shots.textZone: one short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2E3A45 at 16pt
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical camera position, framing and crop. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left panel: an abstract close view of sticky, greasy skin texture with a faint sweat sheen and a compact mirror held over a smudged base, conveying that ordinary sun protection feels heavy and slips off in summer heat, no real face is shown. Right panel: {product} shown as a close side-angle mid-shot at eye level filling 50-60% of the right panel, in cool clean daylight, conveying a weightless finish. Each panel carries one short label 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2E3A45 at 16pt placed along its top edge. Background pale ice-blue #DCEBF5 on both panels. Negative: no real model face, no fabricated statistics or before-after results, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no deformed hands, no over-smoothed plastic skin.

shots.intent: 代入户外海边真实使用，全身大面积涂抹
shots.camera: low 3/4 eye-level in-context, candid handheld feel, model seen from behind
shots.lighting: bright cool daylight from the upper left, 6000K, fine water sheen, soft short contact shadow
shots.background: wet pale-blue #CFE4F2 stone ledge with a blurred sea horizon and soft palm shadows
shots.props: a folded beach towel and a straw hat, neither covering the product
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} resting on a wet pale-blue #CFE4F2 stone ledge at a bright seaside, filling 40-50% of the frame together with the applying hand, with a gently blurred sea horizon and soft palm shadows behind. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a low 3/4 eye level with a candid handheld feel. A model seen from behind and cropped at the chin, in a plain swim top, applies the product to her own shoulder with a flat palm, the product clearly visible and uncovered in frame. Bright cool daylight from the upper left, 6000K, a fine water sheen on the surface, soft short contact shadow. Props: a folded beach towel and a straw hat, not covering the product. Negative: no visible face, no eyes, no deformed hands, no extra or fused fingers, no product covered by hands, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no duplicated background objects, no messy clutter.

shots.intent: 用流动清透的乳体质地证明水感轻薄不厚重
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a low 20-degree raking angle, shallow depth of field, foreground sharp
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing a thin fluid texture and one clean specular highlight
shots.props: a few fine water droplets beside the product
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture itself is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on a glossy thin ribbon of milky lotion flowing from the nozzle onto a wet pale-blue #CFE4F2 glass surface, a few fine water droplets beside it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shot from a low 20-degree raking angle with shallow depth of field, f/3.2, foreground sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing a fluid, water-light, easily spreadable texture with one clean specular highlight. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, with only minimal margins since the texture itself is the whole point. Negative: no blurry subject, no heavy greasy paste look, no props, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no deformed hands.
